feeding_claim.verbatim: Our 100% grass-fed beef is grass-finished, tender, juicy, and healthy.

notes: Unpublished 2026-11-15: confirm whether Snug Valley raises its own beef and pigs or buys them in from other farms. The homepage says the farm uses family-run farms for sourcing animals, the beef page describes 12 to 16 months at Snug Valley on grass and its own hay without saying where calves are born, and the pork page says partner farms supply heritage breed pigs. Beef is grass-finished; pigs get non-GMO grain and hay. Farm store open daily 8am to 6pm at 824 Pumpkin Lane, East Hardwick; online store and Vermont stores and restaurants.
resold_note: Also sells pork from partner farms, Sweet Rowen Farmstead milk and cheese, and maple products from Gebbie's Maplehurst Farm.
